cases.name: sandberg2018-n1000-seed1
cases.note: SEED-FROZEN: mcSeed() derives a deterministic mulberry32 seed from xfnv1a(JSON.stringify({n,preset,ranges,seed:state.seed||1})), so the same {preset,n,priors,seed} always draws the same K samples and gives the same p_alone/p_less1/median_log10N. This fixture asserts reproducibility of that fixed-seed Monte Carlo draw, not independent correctness of the Drake-equation sampling itself (the log-uniform draw-and-sum method is the tool own documented approach, not re-derived here).
